Package com.csse3200.game.components.spells.targeting

Class StrategyWithinRadius

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.spells.targeting.StrategyWithinRadius
All Implemented Interfaces:
EnemyTargetingStrategy
public class StrategyWithinRadius extends Object implements EnemyTargetingStrategy
Selects every enemy within a radius of the caster. Returns an empty array if none are in range.

The radius is fixed when the strategy is built so that whoever casts through it can also show the area it covers, rather than the reach living in one place and the circle drawn in another.

      public float getRadius()
      Specified by:
      getRadius in interface EnemyTargetingStrategy
      Returns:
      how far from the caster this strategy reaches, in world units, or 0 when it is not bounded by a radius. Lets a spell show the area it covered without knowing how it was targeted; an unbounded strategy has no circle to draw.
